After the verb वद् , preceded by अनु when it is intransitively used, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the sense is that of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

The affix ङीप् is not used to denote the feminine after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in अन्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The affix टच् comes after 1. अनस् 2. अश्मन् 3. अयस् and 4. सरस् when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास it denotes a genus or a name.

Terms: टच्
After a कारक as mentioned in कारकाद्दत्तश्रुतयोरेवाशिषि

, the second member ending in the affix अन and denoting an action in the Abstract or the object (i.e. having the senses of Passive Adjective), has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

After अनु a word which is not the Principal as well as कनीयस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

Terms:

The affix मत् gets the augment नुट् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन्।

Terms: नुट् augment
